# Design Document: The verified design system

## Overview

The tokens and rules every screen must follow. Documentation, code and UI checks are generated from the same Lean model.

## Data models

Read from the compiled Lean types.

- `Token`, one of: `deltaBlue`, `navy`, `navyRaised`, `bright`, `red`, `redDark`, `ice`, `paper`, `white`, `mute`, `tint`, `rookieCheek`
- `Use`, one of: `text`, `largeText`, `graphic`
- `Pair`, a structure: `fg: Design.Token`, `bg: Design.Token`, `use: Design.Use`
- `Surface`, one of: `asking`, `decision`, `sameCall`, `possibleCatch`, `consequence`, `report`, `panel`
- `TypeRole`, one of: `display`, `heading`, `caseText`, `body`, `label`
- `Control`, a structure: `name: String`, `height: Nat`
- `Motion`, a structure: `name: String`, `ms: Nat`, `reducedMs: Nat`
